captionZh: 背面视角让 A、B、G、EK、KP、KN 六个排针标签与编码器、按键焊盘的对应关系更清楚。

title: Cover image for the separate hardware SOP

captionZh: 这张图指向以独立笔记与 PDF 保留的自写 SOP；单看封面并不能概括文档内容。

title: Cirro Tech archive cover

title: One Click Connected Windows Temperature to Fan Duty
titleZh: 一次点击，把 Windows 温度接到风扇占空比
caption: The 3:57 recording demonstrates the integrated Windows–Bluetooth SPP–ESP32 chain: temperatures appear in the app, duty and mode appear on the OLED, and the fan responds to data and buttons. It does not contain synchronized temperature, RPM, or performance logs.
captionZh: 这段 3 分 57 秒录像演示了 Windows–Bluetooth SPP–ESP32 完整链路：上位机显示温度，OLED 显示占空比与模式，风扇响应数据和按键；录像不包含同步温度、RPM 或性能日志。

title: Nine A1 mini Build Plates That Remained Digital
titleZh: 停留在数字阶段的九块 A1 mini 切片板
caption: The long enclosure was split across nine A1 mini build plates with automatic tree supports. Modeling and slicing were completed; printing and assembly were not.
captionZh: 长外壳被拆分到九块 A1 mini 切片板，并配置自动树状支撑；建模与切片完成，打印和装配没有进行。

title: Brim and Skirt Settings That Never Reached the Printer
titleZh: 没有走到打印的 Brim 与 Skirt 设置
caption: The unprinted enclosure used three skirt loops, a 5 mm outer brim, and a 0.1 mm gap in this slicing pass. These settings record preparation, not a fabricated result.
captionZh: 这次切片为未打印外壳设置了三圈 Skirt、5 mm 外侧 Brim 与 0.1 mm 间隙；这些参数只记录准备过程，不代表制造结果。

title: Reorienting the Enclosure Parts With Manual Tree Supports
titleZh: 手动支撑下重新摆放外壳分件
caption: A manual-tree-support pass compares orientations for the same enclosure parts. This mechanical revision remained a model and slicing study.
captionZh: 手动树状支撑方案比较了同一组外壳分件的摆放姿态；这版机械结构停留在模型与切片研究阶段。

title: A Tighter STM32 Board Without the Complete Wireless Chain
titleZh: 更紧凑、但未接回完整无线链路的 STM32 板
caption: The STM32 revision reorganized routing and reduced board size while retaining 12 V input, USB-C, two fan interfaces, OLED/Bluetooth headers, and five buttons. The PCB was soldered, powered, and tested by serial fan commands, but not installed in the cooler.
captionZh: STM32 版本重新整理走线并缩小板卡，同时保留 12 V 输入、USB-C、两路风扇、OLED / Bluetooth 排针和五个按键；PCB 完成焊接、上电与串口风扇命令测试，但没有装入散热器。

title: USB-UART and Dual-Fan Interfaces on the STM32 Version
titleZh: STM32 版的 USB-UART 与双风扇接口
caption: The schematic combines an STM32F103C8T6, CH340N USB-UART, dual fan interfaces, 12 V-to-5 V conversion, five buttons, and OLED/Bluetooth headers. Serial fan control was tested; the Windows automatic-temperature path was not restored.
captionZh: 原理图组合了 STM32F103C8T6、CH340N USB-UART、双风扇接口、12 V 转 5 V、五个按键及 OLED / Bluetooth 排针；串口风扇控制完成测试，Windows 自动温度链路没有恢复。

title: FOC Test Board Layout Render
titleZh: FOC 测试板布局渲染图
caption: The V1 render maps the three-phase terminal, USB-C, keys, encoder, OLED header, and power devices; it records layout rather than electrical behavior.
captionZh: V1 渲染图标出三相端子、USB-C、按键、编码器、OLED 排针与功率器件位置；它记录的是布局，不是电气运行结果。

title: STM32F446RET6 Control and Timing Sheet
titleZh: STM32F446RET6 控制与时序分页
caption: The STM32F446RET6 sheet gathers six PWM outputs, ADC inputs, Hall and encoder signals, SPI, USB, SWD, EN_GATE, DC_CAL, FAULT, and OCTW.
captionZh: STM32F446RET6 分页汇集六路 PWM、ADC 输入、Hall 与编码器信号、SPI、USB、SWD、EN_GATE、DC_CAL、FAULT 和 OCTW。

title: Motor, Hall, Power, and Service Connectors
titleZh: 电机、Hall、电源与调试接口分页
caption: The connector sheet routes U/V/W, Hall A_H1/B_H2/C_H3, 12 V input, OLED, serial, fan PWM, ST-Link, and USB-C interfaces.
captionZh: 连接器分页引出 U/V/W、Hall A_H1/B_H2/C_H3、12 V 输入、OLED、串口、风扇 PWM、ST-Link 与 USB-C 接口。

title: Current, Voltage, and Temperature Sampling
titleZh: 电流、电压与温度采样分页
caption: This sheet shows two phase-current inputs, bus current and voltage, three phase-voltage dividers, PCB temperature, and a labeled 1.65 V bias path.
captionZh: 该分页展示两相电流、母线电流与电压、三相电压分压、PCB 温度，以及标注为 1.65 V 的偏置通路。

title: HY3010D Three-Phase Half-Bridge
titleZh: HY3010D 三相半桥功率级
caption: Six HY3010D MOSFETs form the U/V/W half-bridges, with 20 mΩ phase shunts and a 4 mΩ bus shunt visible in the same power-stage sheet.
captionZh: 六颗 HY3010D 组成 U/V/W 三组半桥，同页还能看到 20 mΩ 相电流采样电阻与 4 mΩ 母线采样电阻。

title: DRV8301 Gate Driver and 5 V Supply
titleZh: DRV8301 栅极驱动与 5 V 电源分页
caption: The DRV8301DCAR sheet connects six PWM inputs to three gate pairs and exposes SPI, EN_GATE, nFAULT, OCTW, current-shunt outputs, and a 5 V buck stage.
captionZh: DRV8301DCAR 分页把六路 PWM 接到三组栅极，并引出 SPI、EN_GATE、nFAULT、OCTW、电流采样放大输出和 5 V 降压级。

title: U2 package between the EEV headers
titleZh: EEV 接口之间的 U2 封装
caption: The render shows a four-signal header, an SOP16 U2 package, a five-position output connector, and four LED footprints; the paired schematic identifies U2 as ULN2003A.
captionZh: 渲染显示四路信号排针、SOP16 的 U2 封装、五位输出连接器与四个 LED 位置；配套原理图才把 U2 标为 ULN2003A。

title: Four EEV channels through a ULN2003A
titleZh: 穿过 ULN2003A 的四路 EEV 通道
caption: The schematic routes four inputs through ULN2003A channels to the output connector and attaches an LED-resistor branch to each driven node.
captionZh: 原理图让四路输入穿过 ULN2003A 通道到达输出连接器，并在每个驱动节点上接一支 LED 电阻支路。

captionZh: DeepSeek 生成的 Mermaid 图把分工画开：Ninja 调度依赖图，编译器生成目标文件，链接器再产出可执行程序。

captionZh: Notion 笔记中的另一张生成图比较了 Qt 包发现时的 CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH、Qt6_DIR 与系统默认路径。

titleZh: Qt 安装目录分工图

captionZh: 生成式目录图把 bin 标为运行时工具区、include 标为开发头文件区、lib 标为链接文件区，lib/cmake 则放包配置。

captionZh: 生成式时序图展示 windeployqt 扫描可执行程序的 Qt 依赖，并把核心 DLL、平台插件与资源复制到部署目录。

title: Build-failure first-check map

captionZh: 最后一张生成式排错图从第一条错误开始，再按现象分到架构/编译器、生成器参数或构建类型检查。

title: Two BCD display paths in the report
titleZh: 两条 BCD 显示链的报告示意图
caption: The report written by my teammates fans an Arduino Uno into two decoder/display branches and places two switches alongside them. It records the system topology; the breadboard I built and integrated used an Arduino Nano.
captionZh: 组员撰写的作业报告从 Arduino Uno 分出两路译码/显示支路，并在旁边接入两个开关。它记录的是系统拓扑；我实际联调的面包板使用 Arduino Nano。

title: The 17-second clip only captured changing digits
titleZh: 只留下数字变化的 17 秒现场视频
caption: The clip only shows both digits changing while the Arduino Nano remains powered; it does not capture a button press. Pause and reset passed the classroom demonstration, but this video cannot serve as visual evidence for them.
captionZh: 镜头只拍到了 Arduino Nano 上电后两位数字持续变化，没有拍下按键操作。暂停和复位最终通过了课堂演示，但不能拿这段视频充当它们的影像证据。

title: A17 rollover, pause, and reset requirements
titleZh: A17 归零、暂停与复位要求
caption: This slide defines the group-number build: two digits, rollover after 17, plus pause and reset. Counting through 99 was a separate version that I produced by changing the threshold, then flashed and demonstrated independently.
captionZh: 这页课件定义了小组号版本：两位显示，到 17 后归零，并支持暂停和复位。计数到 99 再归零是另一个改完阈值后单独烧录、单独验证的版本。

title: The three-stage display path I only understood later
titleZh: 我后来才看懂的三段显示链路
caption: The slide reduces the system to Arduino, BCD decoder, and seven-segment display. During the project I was connecting those stages one at a time; only later did I join software state, decoder outputs, and LED current into one explanation.
captionZh: 课件把系统压成 Arduino、BCD 译码器和数码管三段。项目当时我只是在逐段接通；现在回看，才真正把软件状态、译码输出和 LED 电流路径连成一条链。

title: BCD logic does not define the current direction
titleZh: BCD 逻辑之外，还有电流方向
caption: The slide marks A-D inputs, a-g outputs, power, and segment resistors around a 7447-style device. Four BCD bits select a number; whether it lights still depends on output polarity, the display common, and the actual current path.
captionZh: 这页标出了 7447 类器件的 A-D 输入、a-g 输出、供电和段限流。四位 BCD 只决定数字；显示能否点亮，还取决于驱动极性、公共端和实际电流路径。

title: A six-pin switch mapped with a multimeter
titleZh: 靠万用表摸清的六脚按键
caption: Without a matching datasheet, the six pins produced no response, unstable readings, and repeated triggers. I borrowed a multimeter and checked continuity pair by pair before reconnecting the pause and reset functions.
captionZh: 没有对应数据手册时，六只脚让我遇到没反应、乱跳和重复触发。我借来万用表逐对测通断，先确认按下前后的内部连接，再把暂停和复位接回程序。

title: From a one-digit demo to two-digit integration
titleZh: 从一位 demo 到两位联调
caption: Development roughly followed the course sequence: read the material, run a one-digit BCD example, wire two digits, split units and tens, add the buttons, then integrate the system. The two demo sketches were early checkpoints, not the final program.
captionZh: 实际开发大致沿着课件顺序推进：先读资料和跑一位 BCD 示例，再铺两位接线、拆分个位与十位、加入按键，最后联调。两份 demo sketch 都只是前期检查点。

title: The CD4511 simulation omitted a polarity assumption
titleZh: 漏掉极性前提的 CD4511 仿真
caption: TinkerCAD uses a CD4511 to drive a common-cathode display, while the physical LS47 path was intended for common-anode operation. Both decode BCD, but they cannot use the same common-pin connection; that mismatch produced the dark or scrambled display.
captionZh: TinkerCAD 用 CD4511 驱动共阴数码管，实物的 LS47 路径却面向共阳显示。两者都做 BCD 译码，但不能共用同一个公共端接法；这正是当时不亮/乱码故障的来源。

title: Two decoder branches in the A17 report
titleZh: A17 报告中的双译码支路
caption: The cropped report places two decoders between an Arduino Uno and two displays, with resistors and switches nearby. It captures the intended branch relationship; the circuit I built and integrated on the bench used an Arduino Nano.
captionZh: 报告裁图把两颗译码器放在 Arduino Uno 与两位数码管之间，旁边还有电阻和开关。它说明了预期支路关系；我实际搭建和联调的是 Nano 面包板版本。

title: How one state becomes units and tens
titleZh: 一个状态怎样拆成个位和十位
caption: `Num % 10` extracts units and `(Num / 10) % 10` extracts tens. Each result selects a four-bit BCD row for its own decoder; this was the two-digit split I learned while building the project.
captionZh: `Num % 10` 取个位，`(Num / 10) % 10` 取十位；两个结果各自查一行四位 BCD，再送进两颗译码器。这是我当时边查资料边学会的两位显示拆分。

title: A button screenshot that cannot settle the final wiring
titleZh: 无法替最终硬件下结论的按键截图
caption: The excerpt checks switch 1 with HIGH and switch 2 with LOW, while the report also mentions a pull-up. Both buttons passed the classroom demonstration, but without the final wiring and source this image cannot prove a tidy polarity or debounce implementation.
captionZh: 截图里 switch 1 用 HIGH，switch 2 用 LOW，报告文字还提到上拉。最终两个按键确实通过了课堂演示，但缺少最终源码与接线，不能据此补出一套整齐的极性或消抖实现。

title: Course Reference Smart-Car Assembly
titleZh: 课程参考车装配示意
caption: The green reference car shows the kit's intended layout—Nano-format controller, two driven wheels, battery holder, and front collision arms—but is not the purple build documented in this project.
captionZh: 绿色参考车展示套件的预期布局：Nano 尺寸控制板、两只驱动轮、电池盒和前缘碰撞拨杆；它并非本项目记录的紫色实物。

title: Purple Chassis From Below
titleZh: 紫色小车底面
caption: The underside of the assembled purple chassis exposes the through-hole joints, six downward-facing IR tracking sensors, two drive wheels, ball caster, and long-arm collision switches around the edge.
captionZh: 装配后的紫色底盘翻到背面，通孔焊点、六个朝下的红外循迹传感器、两只驱动轮、滚珠万向轮和沿板边布置的长臂碰撞开关都直接可见。

title: Populating the Purple PCB at the Bench
titleZh: 在焊台上装配紫色 PCB
caption: The assembly record catches the board mid-solder, with its circular parts map open on the monitor and a multimeter beside the iron.
captionZh: 装配记录停在焊接进行时：显示器上打开圆形元件布局图，电烙铁旁放着万用表。

title: Power, Inputs, and Motion in One Diagram
titleZh: 一张图串起电源、输入与运动
caption: The manual connects four AAA cells through a power IC to the controller, routes PWM through L293 to two motors, and returns six IR inputs, six switches, and two keys through 74XX165.
captionZh: 手册把四节 AAA 电池经电源芯片接到控制器，再让 PWM 经 L293 驱动双电机；六路红外、六个开关和两个按键则通过 74XX165 返回主控。

title: From Soldering to Troubleshooting
titleZh: 从焊接走到故障排查
caption: The course frame separates four aims: practise soldering; build the car from the given circuit; troubleshoot and solve problems; and work as a team while writing a professional report.
captionZh: 课程把目标拆成四项：练习焊接；按给定电路完成小车装配；开展故障排查与问题解决；以团队协作完成专业报告。

title: LM7805 Sets the 5 V Rail
titleZh: LM7805 建立 5 V 电源轨
caption: The course slide's schematic places 100 µF and 0.01 µF capacitors on both sides of the LM7805 and labels a 5 V output, linking the regulator stage to supply filtering.
captionZh: 课件页原理图在 LM7805 输入、输出两侧各放置 100 µF 与 0.01 µF 电容，并标出 5 V 输出，把稳压级与电源滤波联系起来。

title: Reflection, Collision, and Wheel Speed
titleZh: 反射、碰撞与轮速
caption: The course slide separates contact inputs from optical ones: an impact switch and a key, an emitter–receiver pair for black/white tracking, and a striped wheel read by an IR speed sensor.
captionZh: 课件页把接触输入与光学输入分开：碰撞开关与按键负责触发，收发一体的红外对管辨别黑白，条纹轮盘则由红外测速传感器读取。

title: Fourteen Inputs, One Serial Read Path
titleZh: 十四路输入，一条串行读取路径
caption: The course slide counts six collision switches, six IR channels, and two keys as fourteen inputs; its parallel-in/serial-out model explains why the kit cascades two 74HC165s before the controller.
captionZh: 课件页把六个碰撞开关、六路红外和两个按键合计为十四路输入；并入串出的模型解释了套件为何在主控前级联两颗 74HC165。

title: L293 Reverses the Geared Motors
titleZh: L293 让减速电机正反转
caption: On the course slide, the H-bridge sketches show how reversing the applied polarity changes motor direction; L293 packages that drive stage between the controller and two geared motors.
captionZh: 课件页中的 H 桥示意图说明反转施加极性会改变电机方向；L293 把这一级驱动封装在控制器与两只减速电机之间。

title: Duty Cycle Sets Average Motor Drive
titleZh: 占空比设定电机平均驱动
caption: The course slide's 50% and 80% pulse trains, plus 10/50/90% examples, show how duty cycle changes the average drive applied to a motor; the project code then adjusts the left- and right-wheel PWM commands separately.
captionZh: 课件页用 50% 与 80% 脉冲列和 10/50/90% 示例说明占空比如何改变施加到电机的平均驱动；项目代码随后分别调整左右轮的 PWM 指令。

title: Six Tests Before Full Line Tracking
titleZh: 完整循迹前的六项测试
caption: The course slide prescribes separate checks for LED, keys, collision switches, IR tracking channels, motors, and IR speed sensing; the supplied code also offered variants with and without the RGB LED.
captionZh: 课件页规定逐项检查 LED、按键、碰撞开关、红外循迹通道、电机和红外测速；配套代码还提供带 RGB LED 与不带 LED 两种版本。

title: One Lap Brings the Signal Chain Together
titleZh: 一圈赛道把整条链路接起来
caption: The optional course slide asks the car to follow one black-line lap, awarding a 3% bonus within 70 s and another 2% for beating half the groups; the project record later reports a top-5% finish.
captionZh: 可选挑战课件页要求小车沿黑线跑完一圈：70 秒内完成可获 3% 额外加分，超过半数小组再获 2%；项目记录显示这台车最终进入圈速前 5%。
